Settings_CalendarNotifications.Header: Notify one minute before a meeting

Settings_ClaudeEffort.Description: low, medium, high, xhigh, or max.
Settings_ClaudeOptions.Description: Model alias and effort passed to the Claude CLI.
Settings_CodexOptions.Description: Model and reasoning effort passed to the Codex CLI.
Settings_LanguagePicker.Description: Changes the language of Vozella's own screens. Restart the app to finish switching.
Settings_LiveDropsCaption: Last live session: {0}% of audio skipped
Settings_LiveDropsWarning.Title: Live transcript skipped audio
Settings_LiveDropsWarningMessage: Live transcript skipped {0}% of the audio. The final transcript after Stop is complete; a slow backend (CPU) usually causes this.
Settings_LiveTranscription.Description: On-screen captions with Nemotron while you record. The saved transcript always uses Nemotron after you stop. Turning this off skips only the live preview.
Settings_MeetingPopup.Description: Shows a small popup with a Start recording button when a Zoom, Teams, or Meet call is detected. Stays quiet while you are already recording.
Settings_MeetingPopup.Header: Show a popup when a call starts
Settings_NemotronCard.Description: ~0.74 GB model; runtime extra (CPU ~5 MB or CUDA ~106 MB). Official NVIDIA binaries — nothing else to install.
Settings_RecordingDevice.Description: Which physical microphone Vozella records your voice from. System default follows whatever Windows currently uses.
Settings_SpeakerLabels.Description: Optional Sortformer model (~0.14 GB). Uses extra GPU/CPU while transcribing and labels up to four voices as Speaker 1–4. Turn off to transcribe without who-spoke tags.
Settings_SummaryLanguage.Description: Language of the written summary and action items. Defaults to Spanish. Markdown headings stay in English so the app can parse them.
Settings_SummaryModels.Description: Runs entirely on this PC — no account, no server, no cost. Download the models you want to use and pick one as active; delete any you no longer need to reclaim disk space.
Settings_SummaryProviderCard.Description: Local runs entirely on this PC for free. Claude Code and Codex use an already-installed CLI. Grok (xAI) signs in with SuperGrok or an API key.
Settings_TranscriptionLanguage.Descripti: Pin the meeting language so transcription does not have to guess. Auto-detect is fine when meetings mix languages or you are not sure.
Settings_TypeSafeApiKey.Description: Stored on this PC with Windows encryption. Never written to settings.json.
Settings_TypeSafeEnabled.Description: Sends the transcript to TypeSafe to check action items. Off by default until you save a key.
Settings_XaiAccount.Description: Sign in with SuperGrok (device code) or paste an API key from console.x.ai. Saving one replaces the other.
Settings_XaiApiKey.Description: Optional. For people who prefer a key from console.x.ai.
Settings_XaiEffort.Description: How hard Grok thinks. Low is faster; high is slower and more thorough.
